dog.description_text:
Meet Mogwai!

Mogwai is a 3-year-old with an irresistibly cute face and a goofy personality to match! He’s a smart little guy who learns quickly and loves showing off how clever he is. When he’s not being his silly self, Mogwai is happiest snuggled up with his people. He’s affectionate, cuddly, and ready to bring lots of laughs and love into his forever home.

If you’re looking for a fun, loving companion with plenty of personality, Mogwai may be your perfect match! Click the “Adopt Me” Button to learn more about Mogwai!

*You can meet animals located at the ASPCA Adoption Center during our walk-in hours (daily, noon to 5 p.m.). We encourage a $150 suggested adoption fee when adopting an animal. This adoption fee allows the ASPCA to continue our lifesaving work and help even more animals in need. We are grateful for any amount given at the time of adoption.*
